signals.headline: Production is still running ahead of retail demand
signals.summary: Official July data put industrial growth well above retail-sales growth while fixed-asset investment remained in contraction.
signals.context: The signal is the widening mix: manufacturing and high-tech output remain stronger than consumer spending and investment. Follow whether subsequent releases narrow that gap.

signals.headline: Alibaba is raising equity to keep the AI buildout moving
signals.summary: A $10.2 billion Hong Kong placement follows a quarter in which heavy AI infrastructure spending pushed profit sharply lower.
signals.context: The financing links capital-market dilution directly to the cost of the AI race. Watch how quickly spending turns into cloud demand, model revenue and operating leverage.

signals.headline: Brazil's AI buildout is splitting contracts between Chinese and US suppliers
signals.summary: A national supercomputer push is allocating projects across rival technology blocs rather than choosing a single stack.
signals.context: The durable story sits in procurement: which suppliers win compute, networking and power contracts, and what restrictions follow the hardware into operation.

signals.headline: Household confidence remains the missing transmission channel
signals.summary: July's official release showed retail sales growing far more slowly than industrial output while the urban unemployment rate moved higher.
signals.context: This lead connects the latest household-demand figures with Galok Research 001. The next check is whether wage security and employment quality begin to support spending without another subsidy cycle.

signals.headline: Store counts conceal the turnover inside the network
signals.summary: Gross openings can rise while individual stores, operators and neighborhoods experience rapid replacement.
signals.context: Retained as the evidence trail behind Galok Research 002 and future updates to the replication package.

signals.headline: The border city is read through frequency, not skyline
signals.summary: Shenzhen becomes legible through bay, crossing, street, ridge and light—five rhythms that resist a single innovation-city image.
signals.context: A field-note brief connecting the new Shenzhen city page to wider questions of movement, work and regional identity.
